name: MOT_QM_TERRITORY_QUOTAS
description: Stores all information relating to the quota of a particular territory for all quota plans.

columns.name: TERRITORY_QUOTA_ID
columns.description: Primary Key

columns.name: PROPOSAL_ID
columns.description: Used for proposal integration. Stores the proposal id that affected the options record.

columns.name: SEASONALITY_APPLIED_FLAG
columns.description: Tentative. Whether seasonality  has been applied for this territory.

columns.name: QUOTA_REPUBLISHED_FLAG
columns.description: Used for proposal integration. Indicates whether  the territory has been published within a draft proposal.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: TERRITORY_ID
columns.description: TerritoryId from MOT_TERRITORIES

columns.name: TERRITORY_VERSION_ID
columns.description: Territory Verison Id from MOT_TERRITORIES

columns.name: QUOTA_PLAN_ID
columns.description: FK: MOT_QM_QUOTA_PLANS

columns.name: TERRITORY_QUOTA
columns.description: Quota assigned to this territory

columns.name: PAD_ADJUSTMENT
columns.description: The pad adjustment over and abive the territory quota for this territory

columns.name: PREDICTED_QUOTA
columns.description: Quota predicted using the prediction formulae

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of this territory quota - PUBLISHED/NON-PUBLISHED/PENDING REVISION

columns.name: COMMITED_DATE
columns.description: Date on which the quota has been published

columns.name: DUE_DATE
columns.description: The date by which the quota allocation process must be completed for this territory

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: The start date of the quota period

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: The start date of the quota period

columns.name: SPREAD_FORMULA_ID
columns.description: FK : MOT_QM_SPREAD_FORMULA_B

columns.name: SPREAD_PERIOD
columns.description: The period for which the desired data must be retrieved from the essbase cube

columns.name: SPREAD_SOURCE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: ADJUSTED_TERRITORY_QUOTA/VARIANCE/ADHOC_AMOUNT

columns.name: SPREAD_SCOPE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: ALL_SUBTERRITORIES/SELECTED_SUBTERRITORIES

columns.name: ALLOCATION_COMMENTS
columns.description: Allocation coments for the quota

columns.name: EXCLUDE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicate whether the territory is part of the quota allocation process

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code

columns.name: CURR_EXCHANGE_RATE
columns.description: Currency exchange rate

columns.name: CRM_CORP_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: CRM corporate curreny code

columns.name: CRM_CURR_CONV_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: CRM currency conversion rate type

columns.name: REALIGNMENT_REASON
columns.description: Reason of realignment

columns.name: TERRITORY_REALIGNED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicated is this territory has been religned

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Contains the party id of the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.
